distance_scale.scope: Five authored render distance/fade classes, original culling retained; not geometric mesh LOD

cascaded_shadows.scope: Native disabled cascade path; does not resize or release atlas, does not disable all local/hero shadows

unavailable.geometric_lod: Distance/fade publisher is verified, but no verified mesh-selection producer/consumer contract or safe asset transitions.
unavailable.shadow_quality: Cascade viewport derives from target dimensions and per-scene scale; atlas allocation/recreation and shader consistency have not been validated.
unavailable.local_shadow_quality: Per-model cast-shadow setter changes a model flag and dirty revision; it is not a global local/hero shadow quality control.
unavailable.vfx_quality: Distance classifier is shared through virtual wrappers with visibility/lifecycle return codes; critical gameplay-effect classification and density/spawn budget contract remain unverified. No hide-all switch exposed.
